source.baseline_overlay: K4B original unmodified in-memory source-repair overlay

hypothesis: Pushing CONTROL_A_B reward drift follows from absent checkpoint restoration of the three pushing-specific previous_* reward inputs (end effector positions, object position and object orientation), despite restored physics and RNG.

preregistered_design.restore_rule: Only arm B: snapshot the three previous_* task attributes using deepcopy at checkpoint; restore them after the exact unchanged K4B env.set_state call before each continuation. Never alter physics, RNG, other model or sensor fields.
preregistered_design.order: For each seed × joint, instantiate a fresh pushing environment per arm, same public actions and seeds; full CONTROL_A→restore→CONTROL_B; arm B additionally treated A and B intervention then control C. All 4 cases × 2 arms in each of 2 fresh processes.
preregistered_design.expected_baseline: All four arm-A cases reproduce K4D's initial-step reward-only mismatch; if any do not, report HYPOTHESIS_NOT_IDENTIFIED, without selecting another seed.
preregistered_design.expected_repair: All arm-B cases have exact A/B control replay, exact treated A/B and post-intervention control C, observed physical consequence, and no unrelated state drift, with independent-process digests identical.
preregistered_design.ablations: The sole changed variable is snapshot/restore of three pushing task history fields; a nonmatching checkpoint or unexpected task state blocks evaluation.
preregistered_design.comprehensive_fail_policy: Do not stop other cases on one negative; preserve first failing step/fields for both arms; retain every original negative and distinguish infrastructure failure from mechanism falsification.
